quotes.chinese: 权力导致腐败，绝对的权力绝对导致腐败。
quotes.english: Power tends to corrupt, and absolute power corrupts absolutely.
quotes.author: 阿克顿勋爵
quotes.source: 《致曼德尔·克赖顿主教的信》1887年

quotes.chinese: 伟人几乎总是坏人，即使在他们运用影响力而非权威之时；当你加上权威所带来的腐败倾向或必然性时更是如此。
quotes.english: Great men are almost always bad men, even when they exercise influence and not authority; still more when you superadd the tendency or the certainty of corruption by authority.
quotes.author: 阿克顿勋爵
quotes.source: 《致曼德尔·克赖顿主教的信》1887年

quotes.chinese: 邪恶的平庸性。
quotes.english: The banality of evil.
quotes.author: 汉娜·阿伦特
quotes.source: 《艾希曼在耶路撒冷：关于平庸之恶的报告》
quotes.source_en: Eichmann in Jerusalem: A Report on the Banality of Evil

quotes.chinese: 唯一不能被宽恕的恶习是虚伪。伪君子的忏悔本身就是虚伪。
quotes.english: The only vice that cannot be forgiven is hypocrisy. The repentance of a hypocrite is itself hypocrisy.
quotes.author: 威廉·哈兹里特

quotes.chinese: 只有伪君子才是真正腐烂到骨子里的。
quotes.english: Only the hypocrite is really rotten to the core.
quotes.author: 汉娜·阿伦特

quotes.chinese: 地狱中最炽热的地方，留给那些在道德危机中保持中立的人。
quotes.english: The hottest places in hell are reserved for those who in time of moral crisis preserve their neutrality.
quotes.author: 但丁·阿利吉耶里

quotes.chinese: 理解自身的阴暗，是对付他人阴暗一面的最好方法。
quotes.english: Understanding your own darkness is the best method for dealing with the darkness of others.
quotes.author: 卡尔·荣格
quotes.source_en: The Collected Works of C.G. Jung

quotes.chinese: 大多数人并不真的想要自由，因为自由包含责任，而大多数人害怕责任。
quotes.english: Most people do not really want freedom, because freedom involves responsibility, and most people are frightened of responsibility.
quotes.author: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德

quotes.chinese: 人类从历史里学到一个教训，那就是没有学到任何教训。
quotes.english: We learn from history that we do not learn from history.
quotes.author: 黑格尔
quotes.source_en: Lectures on the Philosophy of History

quotes.chinese: 无知者是最不自由的，因为他要面对的是一个完全黑暗的世界。
quotes.english: The ignorant man is the most unfree, because he has to face a completely dark world.
quotes.author: 黑格尔

quotes.chinese: 人的内心，既求生，也求死。我们既追逐光明，也追逐黑暗。
quotes.english: In the human heart, there is a drive for life and a drive for death. We pursue light and we pursue darkness.
quotes.author: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德

quotes.chinese: 当树向光明和高处生长时，它的根就向泥土、向黑暗、向邪恶扎得更深。
quotes.english: The more a tree reaches toward the light and the heights, the deeper its roots push into the earth, into the darkness, into evil.
quotes.author: 弗里德里希·尼采

quotes.chinese: 与恶龙缠斗过久，自身亦成为恶龙；凝视深渊过久，深渊将回以凝视。
quotes.english: He who fights with monsters should look to it that he himself does not become a monster. And when you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss also gazes into you.
quotes.author: 弗里德里希·尼采

quotes.chinese: 以不义开始的事情，必须用罪恶使它巩固。
quotes.english: Things bad begun make strong themselves by ill.
quotes.author: 威廉·莎士比亚

quotes.chinese: 恶魔可以引用圣经来达到自己的目的。
quotes.english: The devil can cite Scripture for his purpose.
quotes.author: 威廉·莎士比亚

quotes.chinese: 衣服也许能伪装，但言语却暴露一切。
quotes.english: The apparel oft proclaims the man.
quotes.author: 威廉·莎士比亚

quotes.chinese: 疯子带瞎子走路，这就是这个时代的病态。
quotes.english: The blind leading the blind — that is the sickness of this age.
quotes.author: 威廉·莎士比亚

quotes.chinese: 所有人都热爱权力，但没有人愿意承担责任。
quotes.english: All men love power, but no one is willing to bear responsibility.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 欲望具有兽性，纵然最优秀者，一旦大权在握，总倾向于被欲望的激情所腐蚀。
quotes.english: Desire is beast-like, and even the best men, once they hold great power, tend to be corrupted by the passions of desire.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 权力从来不会自愿放弃，它只能被夺取。
quotes.english: Power never relinquishes itself voluntarily; it can only be taken.
quotes.author: 乔治·奥威尔

quotes.chinese: 谁控制过去，谁就控制未来；谁控制现在，谁就控制过去。
quotes.english: Who controls the past controls the future. Who controls the present controls the past.
quotes.author: 乔治·奥威尔

quotes.chinese: 权力不是手段，而是目的。
quotes.english: Power is not a means; it is an end.
quotes.author: 乔治·奥威尔
quotes.source: 《关于詹姆斯·伯纳姆的再思考》

quotes.chinese: 人之所以痛苦，是因为追求错误的东西。
quotes.english: Man suffers because he pursues the wrong things.
quotes.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基

quotes.chinese: 魔鬼跟上帝搏斗，战场就是人心。
quotes.english: The devil is fighting God, and the battlefield is the human heart.
quotes.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基

quotes.chinese: 每个人心中都有一片荒芜的夜地，留给那个幽暗又寂寞的自我。
quotes.english: In every heart there is a barren night, left for that dark and lonely self.
quotes.author: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德

quotes.chinese: 人类的真正区别是这样的：光明中人和黑暗中人。
quotes.english: The true distinction between human beings is this: those of light and those of darkness.
quotes.author: 维克多·雨果

quotes.chinese: 人心的冷酷比黑暗更厉害。因为人心的冷酷是出自人们的意志的。
quotes.english: The coldness of the human heart is worse than darkness. Because the coldness of the heart comes from people's will.
quotes.author: 维克多·雨果

quotes.chinese: 人造的风暴比海洋上的风暴更厉害。
quotes.english: The storms made by man are worse than the storms on the ocean.
quotes.author: 维克多·雨果

quotes.chinese: 权力崇拜模糊了政治判断，因为它几乎不可避免地导致……
quotes.english: Power worship blurs political judgement because it leads, almost unavoidably ...
quotes.author: 乔治·奥威尔
quotes.source: 《关于詹姆斯·伯纳姆的再思考》

quotes.chinese: 作恶比行善更容易被原谅，因为人们更容易理解邪恶的动机。
quotes.english: It is easier to forgive evil than good, because people more easily understand the motives of evil.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 不管恶棍如何邪恶，他们也不敢公然敌视美德，所以当他们试图攻击它时，就会装作发现了它的虚假，或是将罪恶归咎于它。
quotes.english: However evil villains may be, they dare not openly oppose virtue, so when they try to attack it, they pretend to have discovered its falsehood or to attribute crimes to it.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 伪善是邪恶向美德致敬。
quotes.english: Hypocrisy is the homage that vice pays to virtue.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们都有足够的力量去承受他人的不幸。
quotes.english: We all have enough strength to endure the misfortunes of others.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们很少想到我们所拥有的，却总是想着我们所没有的。
quotes.english: We seldom think of what we have, but always of what we lack.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 即使是最诚实的人，也有不愿让人知道的秘密。
quotes.english: Even the most honest person has secrets he does not want others to know.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 人人都有缺陷，但最大的缺陷是以为自己没有缺陷。
quotes.english: Everyone has faults, but the greatest fault is thinking one has none.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们太容易被奉承所迷惑，以至于忘记了真相。
quotes.english: We are so easily deceived by flattery that we forget the truth.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们都喜欢看到别人的失败，因为这让我们感觉更好。
quotes.english: We all like to see the failures of others, because it makes us feel better.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 人们永远不会像他们应该的那样善良，也永远不会像他们可能的那样邪恶。
quotes.english: People are never as good as they should be, nor ever as evil as they might be.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 最难以忍受的不公正，是我们自己遭受的不公正。
quotes.english: The most intolerable injustice is the injustice we ourselves suffer.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 善良是我们假装拥有的美德中最常被模仿的。
quotes.english: Goodness is the most frequently imitated of all the virtues we pretend to possess.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们对他人缺点的宽容，往往只是对自己相同缺点的纵容。
quotes.english: Our tolerance of others' faults is often just indulgence of the same faults in ourselves.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 自爱是最伟大的奉承者。
quotes.english: Self-love is the greatest of all flatterers.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 没有人比那些不愿看见的人更盲目。
quotes.english: No one is blinder than those who do not wish to see.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们经常原谅那些让我们厌烦的人，却很少原谅那些我们厌烦的人。
quotes.english: We often forgive those who bore us, but we rarely forgive those whom we bore.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们承诺时总是慷慨，履行时总是吝啬。
quotes.english: We are always generous in promising, and always stingy in fulfilling.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 人们之所以能够坚持不懈地追求某个目标，往往是因为他们不知道目标的真相。
quotes.english: People can persist in pursuing a goal often because they do not know the truth of the goal.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 大多数人的感恩不过是一种隐秘的期待，期待得到更大的恩惠。
quotes.english: The gratitude of most people is nothing but a secret expectation of greater favors.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 如果我们的美德既没有人承认也没有人欣赏，那么，从人性的角度说，它又有什么必要存在？
quotes.english: If our virtues were neither recognized nor appreciated, from the perspective of human nature, what need would there be for them?
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 能够很好地隐藏自己的感情，是统治他人的一种方式。
quotes.english: To be able to hide one's feelings well is a way of ruling others.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 我们很少发现有人愿意承认自己做了蠢事，但每个人都很容易承认自己做了恶事。
quotes.english: We rarely find anyone willing to admit having done a foolish thing, but everyone easily admits having done a wicked thing.
quotes.author: 拉罗什富科

quotes.chinese: 人世间的一切黑暗都是社会制度造成的。
quotes.english: All the darkness in the human world is caused by social institutions.
quotes.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯

quotes.chinese: 得志的蠢才受宠，而有才华的人倒下，人们竟无动于衷，这就是我们倒霉的教育和风气所造成的结果。
quotes.english: When fools in power are favored while the talented fall, and people remain indifferent — that is the result of our wretched education and customs.
quotes.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯

quotes.chinese: 良心是我们每个人身上的法官，直到我们把它杀死。
quotes.english: Conscience is the judge in each of us, until we kill it.
quotes.author: 马克·吐温

quotes.chinese: 人是唯一会脸红、或者需要脸红的动物。
quotes.english: Man is the only animal that blushes — or needs to.
quotes.author: 马克·吐温

quotes.chinese: 所有人都有弱点，但有些人把弱点变成了武器。
quotes.english: All people have weaknesses, but some turn their weaknesses into weapons.
quotes.author: 弗朗茨·卡夫卡

quotes.chinese: 一旦你给邪恶提供了寄居之所，它就不再要求你信仰它。
quotes.english: Once you have given evil a place to dwell, it no longer requires you to believe in it.
quotes.author: 弗朗茨·卡夫卡
quotes.source_en: The Great Wall of China: Aphorisms 1917-1919

quotes.chinese: 通往地狱的道路是由善意铺成的。
quotes.english: The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
quotes.author: 塞缪尔·约翰逊

quotes.chinese: 最能唤醒人们注意力的，莫过于残忍的故事。
quotes.english: Nothing awakens people's attention more than stories of cruelty.
quotes.author: 塞缪尔·约翰逊

quotes.chinese: 良心是灵魂的声音，欲望是肉体的声音。
quotes.english: Conscience is the voice of the soul, and desire is the voice of the body.
quotes.author: 让-雅克·卢梭

quotes.chinese: 人天生是自由的，却无往不在枷锁之中。
quotes.english: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.
quotes.author: 让-雅克·卢梭

quotes.chinese: 许多人犯下罪行仅仅因为不能忍受邪恶！
quotes.english: How many people commit crimes simply because they cannot endure evil!
quotes.author: 阿尔贝·加缪

quotes.chinese: 杀死一个人，你就是谋杀者；杀死几百万人，你就是征服者；把所有人杀光，你就是上帝。
quotes.english: Kill one man, and you are a murderer. Kill millions, and you are a conqueror. Kill everyone, and you are a god.
quotes.author: 让·罗斯唐

quotes.chinese: 疯子恐怖的幻觉全都取材于人们的日常生活。
quotes.english: The terrifying hallucinations of madmen are all drawn from people's daily lives.
quotes.author: 威廉·詹姆斯

quotes.chinese: 人类是唯一会笑和哭的动物，因为他是唯一被事物是什么和应该是什么之间的差异所打动的动物。
quotes.english: Man is the only animal that laughs and weeps; for he is the only animal that is struck with the difference between what things are, and what they ought to be.
quotes.author: 威廉·哈兹里特
quotes.source_en: Lectures on the English Comic Writers

quotes.chinese: 我们小指上最轻微的疼痛，比数百万同胞的毁灭更令我们关切和不安。
quotes.english: The least pain in our little finger gives us more concern and uneasiness than the destruction of millions of our fellow beings.
quotes.author: 威廉·哈兹里特

quotes.chinese: 人们说话似乎不是为了表达自己的观点，而是为了说话而维护一种观点。
quotes.english: People do not seem to talk for the sake of expressing their opinions, but to maintain an opinion for the sake of talking.
quotes.author: 威廉·哈兹里特

quotes.chinese: 每个时代都被幻象喂养，以免人们过早放弃生命，人类灭亡。
quotes.english: Every age is fed on illusions, lest men should renounce life early and the human race come to an end.
quotes.author: 约瑟夫·康拉德

quotes.chinese: 人心能容纳一切——因为一切都在其中，所有的过去和所有的未来。
quotes.english: The mind of man is capable of anything—because everything is in it, all the past as well as all the future.
quotes.author: 约瑟夫·康拉德

quotes.chinese: 世界是黑暗的，但黑暗本身并不可怕；可怕的是人。
quotes.english: The world is dark, but darkness itself is not frightening; what is frightening is man.
quotes.author: 约瑟夫·康拉德

quotes.chinese: 在专制统治下，行动比思考容易得多。
quotes.english: Under conditions of tyranny it is far easier to act than to think.
quotes.author: 汉娜·阿伦特

quotes.chinese: 最彻底的革命者，在革命后的第二天就会变成保守派。
quotes.english: The most radical revolutionary will become a conservative on the day after the revolution.
quotes.author: 汉娜·阿伦特

quotes.chinese: 没有什么比他人的习惯更需要改革的了。
quotes.english: Nothing so needs reforming as other people's habits.
quotes.author: 马克·吐温

quotes.chinese: 一个人最危险的敌人，是他自己的口。
quotes.english: A person's most dangerous enemy is his own mouth.
quotes.author: 马克·吐温

quotes.chinese: 如果一个人不懂得如何说不，他就永远无法真正说是。
quotes.english: If a person does not know how to say no, he can never truly say yes.
quotes.author: 弗里德里希·尼采

quotes.chinese: 憎恨比恐惧更容易被激发。
quotes.english: Hate is more quickly aroused than fear.
quotes.author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利

quotes.chinese: 没有什么比群众更反复无常的了……群众的本性是要么奴性地服从，要么傲慢地支配。
quotes.english: Nothing is more inconstant than the masses... it is the nature of the masses to either servilely obey or arrogantly to domineer.
quotes.author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利

quotes.chinese: 被人们畏惧比被人们爱戴要安全得多。
quotes.english: It is much safer to be feared than to be loved.
quotes.author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利

quotes.chinese: 一个人应该缓慢地相信和行动；也不应被自己的恐惧轻易惊动。
quotes.english: A prince should be slow to believe and to act; nor should he be too easily alarmed by his own fears.
quotes.author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利

quotes.chinese: 权力滋生欲望；没有统治者会满足；没有人达到一个位置后不再渴望更进一步。
quotes.english: Power breeds appetite; no rulers are ever satisfied; no one has ever reached a position from which he has no desire to advance further.
quotes.author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利

quotes.chinese: 人们是忘恩负义、不可靠的；他们说谎、造假、贪婪钱财，在危险面前就融化消失。
quotes.english: They are ungrateful and unreliable; they lie, they fake, they're greedy for cash and they melt away in the face of danger.
quotes.author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利

quotes.chinese: 光靠极度的狂热是不够的，还必须在恰当的时刻登场。
quotes.english: To win great fame, extreme fanaticism alone is not enough; one must also appear at the right moment.
quotes.author: 伏尔泰

quotes.chinese: 如果人类的命运总是像人们所想象的那样残暴，那么它将不堪忍受。
quotes.english: If human destiny were always as cruel as people imagine it, it would be unbearable.
quotes.author: 伏尔泰

quotes.chinese: 忘记过去的人注定要重蹈覆辙。
quotes.english: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
quotes.author: 乔治·桑塔亚那

quotes.chinese: 那些给别人带来不幸的人有一个共同的借口，那就是他们的出发点是好的。
quotes.english: Those who bring misfortune to others have a common excuse: that their intentions were good.
quotes.author: 沃维纳格
quotes.author_en: Luc de Clapiers, Marquis de Vauvenargues

quotes.chinese: 每当发现好人居然也很聪明时，恶棍们总感到惊讶。
quotes.english: Villains are always surprised when they find that good people are also clever.
quotes.author: 沃维纳格
quotes.author_en: Luc de Clapiers, Marquis de Vauvenargues

quotes.chinese: 恶劣的天性从不需要指导者。
quotes.english: Bad nature never needs a guide.
quotes.author: 普布利柳斯·西鲁斯

quotes.chinese: 恶毒是狡诈的。
quotes.english: Malice is cunning.
quotes.author: 西塞罗

quotes.chinese: 上帝创造了世界，但使世界保持运转的却是魔鬼。
quotes.english: God created the world, but it is the devil that keeps it running.
quotes.author: 特里斯唐·贝尔纳

quotes.chinese: 如果你想做个好人，那么就从假定你是坏人开始吧。
quotes.english: If you want to be a good person, then start by assuming you are a bad one.
quotes.author: 爱比克泰德

quotes.chinese: 邪恶所能成就的，就是它自己的毁灭。
quotes.english: All that evil can achieve is its own destruction.
quotes.author: 阿尔贝·加缪

quotes.chinese: 在一个不公正的社会里，沉默本身就是一种罪。
quotes.english: In an unjust society, silence itself is a crime.
quotes.author: 阿尔贝·加缪

quotes.chinese: 最大的恶，是那些出于善意的恶。
quotes.english: The greatest evil is the evil done out of good intentions.
quotes.author: 亚历山大·索尔仁尼琴

quotes.chinese: 一个人要么是锤子，要么是砧板。
quotes.english: A person is either a hammer or an anvil.
quotes.author: 弗里德里希·尼采

quotes.chinese: 每一个真正深刻的思想家，都比普通人更害怕被理解。
quotes.english: Every profound thinker is more afraid of being understood than of being misunderstood.
quotes.author: 弗里德里希·尼采

quotes.chinese: 在这个世界上，最危险的事莫过于无知却自以为知道。
quotes.english: In this world, nothing is more dangerous than ignorance combined with the conviction of knowing.
quotes.author: 孔子

quotes.chinese: 骄傲在败坏以先，狂心在跌倒之前。
quotes.english: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 人心比万物都诡诈，坏到极处，谁能识透呢？
quotes.english: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
quotes.author: 耶利米

quotes.chinese: 光来到世间，世人因自己的行为是恶的，不爱光倒爱黑暗。
quotes.english: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.
quotes.author: 使徒约翰

quotes.chinese: 各人最稳妥的时候，真是全然虚幻。
quotes.english: Surely every man at his best is a mere breath; a fleeting shadow.
quotes.author: 大卫
